title: Reduce a carboxylic acid
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Lithium aluminum hydride reduces a carboxylic acid to a primary alcohol after workup. The carbonyl carbon remains in the chain and becomes the carbon bearing OH.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanoic acid under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanoic acid is treated with 1. LiAlH₄; 2. water. Which major organic product forms after workup? Lithium aluminum hydride reduces a carboxylic acid to a primary alcohol after workup. The carbonyl carbon remains in the chain and becomes the carbon bearing OH.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
